en: A vintage black‑and‑white street scene showing a broad cobblestone avenue lined with multi‑story European-style buildings and shops. In the center distance stands a decorated triumphal-style arch spanning the street, with people walking beneath it and early 20th‑century pedestrians and a few officials in uniform scattered in the foreground. Overhead are numerous telegraph or electrical wires. The bottom border of the card has captions in Cyrillic and French, identifying the street and city.
